- Adding Suspense's lines to `.gitignore` still happens for a folder that's in a repository, as before.

- `ImportProjectScope`: `#defaults` (detecting a repository and the checkbox state) and `#importing` (checking again and never running `git init` inside a repository).
- `NewProjectScope`: `#creating` is unchanged.

I added an Import Project feature to the spec: it makes an existing folder into a project, with the same agent, template and root choices as New Project. `piton check` reports no problems, `piton build` wrote 80 files, and the new page is at `.claude/reference/scope/import-project/index.md`.

## What changed in the spec

**1. New Import Project form** (`spec/scope/import-project/index.pi`)
- **`#description`:** an "Import Project" form laid out like New Project. The Name and Location fields are replaced by a single "Folder" row. Everything else is the same: the Git checkbox, spec/code/shape roots, template and agents. The buttons are Cancel and Import.
- **`#folder`:**
  - Browse opens the folder browser, titled "Choose the folder to import".
  - The project is named after the folder.
  - A folder that already has a `piton.config.pi` is refused, with an "Open it instead" link.
  - A folder you can't write to says so.
- **`#defaults`:**
  - The spec root starts as `./spec`.
  - The code root starts as `./src` if that folder exists, otherwise `./`, meaning the whole folder.
  - The shape root starts as `./spec/shape`.
  - If the folder is already a Git repository, the Git checkbox is checked, disabled and reads "Already a Git repository".
  - A root that already exists is marked "Uses the existing folder".
- **`#importing`:**
  - It writes `piton.config.pi`, and `opencode.json` if OpenCode is checked and there isn't one, the same way New Project does.
  - It creates any missing
- [New Project writes a piton.config.pi exporting a piton-config named in PascalCase, with a BelayConfiguration](.claude/reference/scope/new-project/index.md#config)
- [Agents are checkboxes for Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex; only Claude Code starts checked; at least one](.claude/reference/scope/new-project/index.md#agents)
- [Spec, code, and shape roots are relative paths, never absolute or climbing out with ..](.claude/reference/scope/new-project/index.md#folders)
- [Creating never overwrites anything, and refuses a folder already holding piton.config.pi](.claude/reference/scope/new-project/index.md#creating)
- [With OpenCode checked, an opencode.json is written unless there is one](.claude/reference/scope/new-project/index.md#config)
- [Once created, the project opens as if opened with Open Project](.claude/reference/scope/new-project/index.md#creating)
- [Everything the application creates belongs to the user](.claude/reference/scope/application/index.md#file-ownership)
- [The ribbon's Project group stacks New Project, Import Project, and Open Project, all slim and primary](.claude/reference/ui/components/ribbon/project-tab/index.md#groups)
- [New Project opens in an inset panel, fresh each time, in place of any diff](.claude/reference/scope/application/MainWindow.md#new-project)
- [The palette's system commands mirror the toolbar's, such as Open Project…](.claude/reference/scope/palette/index.md#shape)
- [Import never overwrites, moves, or deletes anything already in the folder; piton.config.pi is written last](.claude/reference/scope/import-project/index.md#importing)
